nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): c = a + b guarded by require(c >= a)
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): require(b <= a) then c = a - b
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): require(b > 0) then c = a / b
address public owner: privileged account controlling onlyOwner functions
address public newOwner: pending owner for two-step ownership transfer
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: sets pending newOwner
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, transfers ownership and resets newOwner

uint8 public decimals (18)
uint public _totalSupply: total token supply set in constructor
mapping(address => uint) balances: token balances
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed: ERC20 allowances
HotDoge() constructor: initialises metadata, supply and pre-mints to a fixed address
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw unchecked subtraction
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner]
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd
approve(address spender, uint tokens): overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender]
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): spends allowance and moves balance
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): approves then invokes spender.receiveApproval(...)
Fallback function: payable, immediately reverts to refuse ETH
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: calls arbitrary token transfer(owner, tokens)
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for auth checks and as balance owner
